provenance.model_input_boundary: Only saved current RGB-D, measured history/pose, goal and proposed geometric references
provenance.proposal_scope: Same six original focused-data route/speed families, plus bounded MPPI refinements; speed<=6m/s. Bounds are not a guarantee of learned support.

routes.label: MPPI selected
routes.role_semantics: Lowest model cost among the scored, allowed candidates; physical optimum is not known

routes.label: Rock-crossing test
routes.role_semantics: Scene-designed collision hypothesis; actual predicted contact probability is reported without alteration

routes.label: Terrain-stall test
routes.role_semantics: Scene-designed terrain-stall hypothesis; a later stall may lie outside the4s learned event horizon

routes.label: Slower clear route
routes.role_semantics: Lower progress means less goal progress at the same4s horizon; a4m/s command may still reach the goal later

unavailable.collision_risk: No distinct candidate has above-threshold predicted contact risk
unavailable.bounded_motion_risk: No distinct contact-low candidate has above-threshold within-horizon bounded-motion risk

prediction_only_risk_categories.selection_scope: Prediction-only representative hypotheses, not guaranteed future Chrono outcomes

display: Solid=model forecast0-4s; dashed=full commanded path; role names are test hypotheses, not overwritten NN classifications
